description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
